**guitarset-e-major.wav** is the mono microphone excerpt from 41.22 to
42.32 seconds of GuitarSet v1.1, player 05, track `05_SS1-68-E_comp`.
The per-string annotations place E2, B2, E3 and G♯3 together from 41.457
to 41.993 seconds. B3 joins the ringing chord at 41.993 seconds.

GuitarSet by Qingyang Xi, Rachel M. Bittner, Johan Pauwels, Xuzhou Ye and
Juan Pablo Bello is licensed under CC BY 4.0. The excerpt was trimmed and
encoded as mono 16-bit PCM for the detector regression test.
